hook_text: 12 of 30 learners chose pizza. Does that mean South Africa loves pizza? Not even close.
clip_script: A conclusion that the data supports: In this sample, walking is the most common way to get to school. Be careful not to claim more than the data shows. The data does not tell us why learners walk, or whether this is true at other schools.
visual_style: A headline 'SA LOVES PIZZA' gets crossed out and replaced by 'Pizza most popular in our class: 40%'.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to write data reports you can trust.
